name: Bounded transport compactness
statement: K compact and A,B bounded imply AKB compact
use: imports CC compactness into semilocal finite-S setting

name: Multiplier noncompactness
statement: On non-atomic L2, nonzero multiplication is not compact
use: rules out raw Euler-factor multiplier as compact correction

name: Projection residual criterion
statement: If R_S compact and CC residual compact, Delta_S compact modulo finite-rank/tail
use: reduces compactness to semilocal prolate projection theorem

name: Compact absorption
statement: If Delta_S^+ compact then finite windows approximate it up to vanishing tail

name: Essential obstruction
statement: If essential norm of Delta_S^+ is positive, compact absorption cannot prove confinement
